external_deps: An agent-capable AI tool (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, etc.)

review.tagline: Agent skill that turns documents into natively editable PowerPoint decks
review.summary: PPT Master is a workflow ("skill") that runs inside an agent-capable AI tool such as Claude Code, Cursor or Codex CLI. It reads source material like PDFs, DOCX and web pages, plans the argument, and exports a .pptx with native shapes, data-backed charts and tables, and slide masters via the template route. It can also fill existing decks, extract templates, and add transitions, animations and narration.
review.audience: People who want editable PowerPoint decks generated from documents by an agent
strengths: Exports native PowerPoint objects (shapes, charts, tables), not flattened images
Runs on your machine; only model API calls leave it
Works with any agent-capable tool and model: Claude, GPT, Gemini, Kimi
Also fills existing .pptx files and distills reusable templates
weaknesses: Output quality depends on the driving model; README recommends Kimi K3 or Claude with ~1M context
Image-heavy decks need a separate AI image generation API such as gpt-image-2
Needs an agent tool installed plus Python 3.10+; no standalone UI
SmartArt is deliberately unsupported; one-shot decks still need manual polish
needs: Needs Python 3.10+, An agent-capable AI tool (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, etc.), pandoc (only for legacy formats like .doc, .odt, .rtf)
Models: Kimi K3, Claude, GPT, Gemini, gpt-image-2
